title: sessions signal
description: Running local Claude Code sessions (live pids in ~/.claude/sessions/*.json), re-read every 15 s. Only each session's working-directory BASENAME leaves the server. GET /api/signals/sessions, polled every 15 s; 404 unless providers.sessions.enabled. No network. SENSITIVE (project folder names).

cwd.description: Basename of the session's working directory.

kind.description: Session kind as recorded by Claude Code (e.g. 'interactive'), or null.
